text: In Kuala Lumpur, public defender Karim is searching for his runaway daughter Nadia when he agrees to defend Diana Dahlan, [a shaman accused of killing a businessman in a pagan ritual|threat|witchcraft and cursed things]. At their first meeting she knows his past, including the years he and his wife struggled to conceive. As detectives [dig into her former homes|trigger|digging into a mystery] and find a body under each, one a woman with only her womb removed, [a bargain that demanded an unborn child|wants|the sacrifice demanded] comes to light.
